title: Bitcoin drops for third straight day as Asian tech shares slide
content: BlackRock’s spot bitcoin ETF recorded the largest single-day outflow since its introduction more than two years ago as investors continued to flee the sector.

title: Coinbase targets first-half 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
content: The move would reduce Coinbase's reliance on a partnership Kalshi, which brought in $200 million in annualized revenue in the third quarter.

title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
content: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
content: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

title: Wrapped Monero token plunges 99% as issuer-linked wallet sells $13.5 million
content: The sell-off hit Wagyu’s XMR1 token, separate from Monero and Hyperliquid’s XMR futures market.

title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
content: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
content: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.

title: Bitcoin nears repeat of chart pattern that preceded 2023’s $25K retest
content: Bitcoin’s 21-day moving average fell below its 200-day average, and analyst Keith Alan expects a second bearish crossover by Sunday.

title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
content: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.

title: SEC charges eight firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
content: Fraudsters allegedly used social media ads, chat groups and forged SEC filings to defraud US investors of approximately $37 million.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $582M in a Day as BTC Drops Below $62K
content: Thursday's ETF outflow was the funds' biggest in three weeks, as rising Treasury yields and Fed rate hike bets weigh on crypto.

title: Coinbase Targets In-House Prediction Markets by First Half of 2027: Report
content: The exchange offers event contracts through Kalshi, but running its own would give it more control and a bigger share of trading revenue.

title: CryptoUK Urges FCA Not to Treat DeFi Devs as Regulated by Default
content: The UK crypto trade group broadly backed the regulator's proposed perimeter guidance, but warned that parts of it go further than the law.

title: Citi Says Customers Are Responsible When AI Banking Agents Go Rogue—Even After a Hack
content: Citibank’s updated terms put customers on the hook for outside AI agents, including leaked logins.

title: Nvidia, AMD, Micron Sink as Anthropic Closes 17% Above IPO Price
content: Anthropic shares opened 34% above their $83 IPO price before giving up much of the gain, while Nvidia, AMD and other AI stocks slid across Wall Street.

title: Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future
content: Bitcoin Magazine Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future On November 10, 2026, President Nayib Bukele hosted roughly 30 Bitcoiners at Casa Presidencial during Bitcoin Histórico. Guests included Ricardo Salinas Pliego, Parker Lewis, Mike Peterson, and miners; discussions covered power generation for compute and immigration. This post Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .

title: Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides
content: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides Strategy shares fell 4.6% to $86.13 on Thursday, their sixth straight decline, as bitcoin dipped below $62,000. The company's 850,849 BTC are now worth about $11 billion less than it paid. This post Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam
content: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam The SEC charged eight Colorado-based entities, likely run from overseas, with taking more than $37 million from U.S. investors through fake advisers, fake crypto trading platforms and fake SEC certificates. This post SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month The bitcoin price slumped under $62,000 on Thursday, down about 24% in one month, as Anthropic's Nasdaq debut set off a tech selloff that hit crypto stocks. This post Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
